## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 26 sept 2026 - 26 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Teresa of the faint smile_, 26 sept 2026, 4/5: "It has issues when syncing with my Apple Watch. Oftentimes, when I start working out, it fails to accurately sync up with my Apple Watch which ruins the workout experience because the timings would be off. Also, as a deaf person, it’d be nice if it can vibrate so I know when to start working out and when to rest rather than having to keep an eye on my iPhone to know the timing."
<!--/ir-theme-->
